# Scope of Work: HubSpot Email Marketing & Lead Automation Implementation

## Project Overview
This scope of work outlines the implementation and configuration of HubSpot's Marketing Hub for email marketing and lead automation capabilities. The project will establish a comprehensive marketing automation system to nurture leads, improve customer engagement, and drive revenue growth.

## Project Objectives
- Implement HubSpot Marketing Hub for email marketing and lead automation
- Create automated lead nurturing workflows
- Establish lead scoring and segmentation systems
- Set up comprehensive email marketing campaigns
- Integrate with existing sales processes and CRM data
- Provide training and documentation for ongoing management

## Scope of Services

### Phase 1: Discovery & Planning (Week 1-2)
**1.1 Current State Assessment**
- Audit existing email marketing tools and processes
- Review current lead generation and nurturing strategies
- Analyze existing customer data and segmentation
- Document current sales and marketing alignment processes
- Identify integration requirements with existing systems (Salesforce, Zapier, etc.)

**1.2 Requirements Gathering**
- Define lead scoring criteria and values
- Map customer journey and touchpoints
- Identify automation triggers and workflows needed
- Determine email campaign types and frequency
- Establish KPIs and success metrics

**1.3 HubSpot Configuration Planning**
- Recommend appropriate HubSpot Marketing Hub tier
- Design automation workflow architecture
- Plan email template designs and content structure
- Create implementation timeline and resource allocation

### Phase 2: HubSpot Setup & Configuration (Week 3-5)

- Configure HubSpot Marketing Hub account
- Set up user permissions and team access
- Configure company and contact properties
- Import and clean existing contact database
- Set up tracking code and analytics

- Create branded email signatures and headers
- Set up sender authentication (SPF, DKIM records)
- Configure subscription preferences and unsubscribe pages

- Welcome email sequences for new subscribers

- Re-engagement campaigns for inactive contacts
- Post-purchase onboarding and upsell sequences
- Event-triggered behavioral workflows

- Lead scoring automation and threshold alerts
- Sales notification workflows for hot leads
- Deal stage progression automation

- Set up social media integrations (LinkedIn, Facebook)
- Configure third-party tool connections (Salesforce, Slack, etc.)

- Validate automation workflow triggers and conditions
- Test lead scoring calculations and assignments
- Verify integration data flow and synchronization

**4.2 User Acceptance Testing**

- HubSpot platform overview and navigation training
- Email campaign creation and management
- Workflow building and automation management
- Lead scoring and contact management
- Reporting and analytics dashboard usage
- Best practices for email marketing compliance (CAN-SPAM, GDPR)

- Monitor automation performance
- Provide immediate troubleshooting support
- Review initial performance metrics
- Make necessary adjustments based on early results
